semantic_contract.selection_vs_delivery: Fresh unsent occurrence invalidation re-enters Target and does not exclude an actually unfailed identity. A stale pending retry following a real failed send closes and excludes the full identity for this request. Consumed failed recovery trials end the active episode independently of resulting health availability. No-send contention never enters Provider failure accounting.
semantic_contract.attempt_custody: Runtime request control carries canonical actual-attempt identity/source/HTTP witness across protocol handoffs until the next actual send. Independent local terminal causes retain precedence. Error alone qualifies final real HTTP projection.
semantic_contract.business_recovery_composition: Occurrence-aware successor observation precedes matching Provider business-trial settlement. A consumed trial failure does not mutate ordinary health twice. Target delivery feedback is independent; hold/tail and queue release never settle Provider health. Acquisition contention before dispatch consumes no delivery failure or new actual-attempt evidence.
semantic_contract.active_key_action: An explicit active policy classifies only an actually dispatched attempt as delivery failure. Error owns the typed Neutral, RetrySelectedActiveKey or Reselect plan; Target feedback supplies fourth-failure transition and Runtime supplies current retry eligibility. Legacy WaitThenRetrySame admission is not used. The action stays internal and never supplies an external HTTP witness.
semantic_contract.session_turn_limit: Runtime consumes a complete genuine Provider HTTP 400 witness with the exact session_turn_limit_exceeded code. For an ordinary conversation it records the provider restriction before observing available successors. A completed health-neutral attempt releases only its matching business recovery trial without changing cooldown or cadence, so a successor can acquire its own trial. This restriction is independent of provider health.
semantic_contract.sink_rule: The one graph sink carries typed internal failure evidence. For a complete genuine non-2xx Provider HTTP response from the current exhausted final identity, it also carries a typed projection-eligibility resource. Server alone converts that qualified witness into the entry protocol; every other terminal remains a transport break and never borrows a prior attempt witness or fabricates a response.
